NOTICE OF COMMISSION’S FINDINGS OF FACT, CONCLUSIONS OF LAW
AND ORDER PURSUANT TO SECTION 111.07(5), STATS.
On November 25, 1998, Examiner David E. Shaw issued Findings of Fact, Conclusions
of Law and Order, with Accompanying Memorandum, in the above-entitled matter determining
that Complainant was precluded from litigating the allegations in its complaint by the doctrine of
claim preclusion. He therefore dismissed the complaint.
No. 29184-C
Page 2

No. 29184-C
Within the 20-day statutory period set forth in Sec. 111.07(5), Stats., no petition for
review of said Findings of Fact, Conclusion of Law and Order was filed and not intervening
order by the Examiner or the Commission was issued.
NOW, THEREFORE, the Commission issues the following
NOTICE
By operation of Sec. 111.07(5), Stats., Examiner Shaw’s Findings of Fact, Conclusions of
Law and Order in the above-entitled matter became the Commission’s Findings of Fact,
Conclusions of Law and Order on December 16, 1998.
Given under our hands and seal at the City of Madison, Wisconsin, this 23rd day of December, 1998.
WISCONSIN EMPLOYMENT RELATIONS COMMISSION
